description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for development and debugging endpoints related to MongoDB status, data seeding, and data verification. It interacts with multiple Mongoose models such as User, Sample, SessionTracking, AppDeployment, Tenant, and Project.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/db-status
methods.description: Returns the status of the MongoDB connection, including connection state, database name, and host.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/seed
methods.description: Seeds initial sample data into the database collections if they are empty, and returns counts and sample documents before and after seeding.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/verify
methods.description: Verifies data availability by returning counts and sample documents from all collections.
